style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Padded Bow Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Add a rich, festive flourish to your seasonal styling with this 140cm padded red bow garland. Designed with soft, voluminous bows in a classic festive red, it brings instant warmth and elegance to any display. The padded texture gives each bow a full, luxurious appearance, creating depth and impact whether draped along a mantelpiece, staircase, doorway or festive table setting. Designed to make decorating effortless, this garland offers a timeless Christmas aesthetic that blends traditional charm with a bold decorative statement. Its generous 140cm length provides excellent coverage while remaining easy to shape and position exactly how you want it. The rich red tones catch the light beautifully, enhancing both modern and traditional festive themes. Perfect for creating a coordinated seasonal look throughout your home, this padded red bow garland is a simple yet striking way to elevate your Christmas décor year after year. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 140cm.
